1. Get the repr of the item
2. If length > max_length, find the last character (usually `}`, `)`, or `]`) and replace everything before it with `...`

```python
def short_repr(item, max_length=15):
    item_repr = repr(item)
    if len(item_repr) > max_length:
        # Find the closing bracket/paren/brace
        closing_char = item_repr[-1]
        # Truncate and add ellipsis before the closing character
        return item_repr[:max_length - 4] + ':...' + closing_char
    return item_repr
```
